import type { ItemView } from '../adapters/itemsAdapter.js';
export function ItemsView({ items, onSave }: { items: ItemView[]; onSave: () => void }) {
  // import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
  const example = "schema.safeParse(wire); document.body";
  return <button title={example} onClick={onSave}>{items.length}</button>;
}
